title: Fictional identity requirements
disclaimer: FICTIONAL TRAINING CONTENT. Created for Fictional Telecom Lab; does not represent any real provider or legal requirement. Knowledge guidance only; no customer actions can be performed.

sections.heading: Training identification
sections.text: In this demonstration, use an unexpired Fictional Training ID card whose name matches the fictional account record. This invented card is only a teaching prop; no actual identity document or personal details should be entered into the application.

sections.heading: Missing or mismatched details
sections.text: If the training card is expired, missing or has a different name, the authorised colleague must refer the case to the Fictional Identity Review Team. The copilot cannot verify identity or invent an alternative document requirement.

sections.heading: Identity and authority are different
sections.text: Establishing who someone is does not establish which account actions they may request. Consult AUTH-1001 separately for authority. This fictional procedure is not a legal or regulatory determination.
